constraints: Evaluate based on legal knowledge and communication skills
agents.goal: Assess the candidate's suitability for the lawyer position
agents.name: Interviewer

constraints: Answer questions without prior knowledge of the interviewer's expectations
agents.goal: Demonstrate legal expertise and interview skills
agents.name: Candidate

constraints: Provide feedback on cultural fit and work ethic
agents.goal: Ensure the candidate meets company standards
agents.name: Recruiter

causes.hypothesis: Higher legal knowledge leads to better hiring decisions
causes.name: Legal knowledge

causes.hypothesis: Strong communication skills improve the likelihood of being hired

causes.hypothesis: Better cultural fit increases the probability of hiring
